abstract: Covers Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR). RFC 8949 Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) is current; RFC 8610 Concise Data Definition Language (CDDL): A Notational Convention to Express Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) and JSON Data Structures is current; RFC 9165 Additional Control Operators for the Concise Data Definition Language (CDDL) is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
